title: Corporate VPN Configuration and Troubleshooting
keywords: vpn, anyconnect, cisco, tunnel, connection timeout, split-tunnel
content: Steps: 1. Restart Cisco AnyConnect. 2. Verify Wi-Fi. 3. Flush DNS cache using ipconfig /flushdns. 4. Re-enter credentials. If error persists, escalate.

title: Active Directory Password Reset & Account Unlock
keywords: password, expired, unlock, lockout, domain controller, credentials
content: Steps: 1. Go to identity portal. 2. Pass MFA challenge. 3. Set password with 14+ characters. 4. Wait 5 minutes for sync across domain controllers.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Authorization & T-Code Access
keywords: sap, fico, t-code, authorization error, financial ledger, posting
content: Steps: 1. Run transaction SU53. 2. Screenshot missing authorization object. 3. Check role matrix. 4. Submit access request for missing entitlement.

title: Microsoft 365 Exchange & Outlook Sync Diagnostics
keywords: outlook, sync, exchange, ost file, disconnected, cached mode
content: Steps: 1. Verify Outlook status bar. 2. Click Send/Receive All. 3. Close Outlook, rename .ost file. 4. Restart Outlook to rebuild cache.

title: Corporate Laptop BitLocker Recovery Procedure
keywords: bitlocker, encryption, recovery key, tpm, blue screen, bios
content: Steps: 1. Retrieve BitLocker recovery key from Intune. 2. Enter 48-digit key at boot prompt. 3. Perform Windows startup diagnostics. 4. Update BIOS if prompted.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Device Re-enrollment
keywords: mfa, authenticator, okta, push, phone replaced, token
content: Steps: 1. Access security self-service. 2. Verify identity via secondary phone. 3. Delete old device. 4. Scan QR code on new authenticator app.

title: Corporate Wi-Fi Certificate Renewal
keywords: wifi, 802.1x, radius, certificate, eduroam, corporate ssid
content: Steps: 1. Forget Northstar-Corp Wi-Fi network. 2. Connect to onboarding network. 3. Download device certificate. 4. Reconnect to corporate SSID.

title: Approved Software Installation via Self-Service Portal
keywords: software, install, portal, intune, company portal, adobe, slack
content: Steps: 1. Open Company Portal. 2. Search for requested software. 3. Click Install. 4. If license requires approval, submit automated access request.

title: Power BI Gateway Refresh Failure Resolution
keywords: power bi, gateway, dataset, scheduled refresh, credential error
content: Steps: 1. Open Power BI Service. 2. Navigate to Dataset Settings. 3. Verify Gateway connection is Online. 4. Re-enter SQL credentials.

title: GitHub Enterprise SSO Integration and Access Grant
keywords: github, git, repo, sso, organization, saml, access denied
content: Steps: 1. Sign in to GitHub Enterprise. 2. Authorize Northstar SAML SSO prompt. 3. Request team membership. 4. Verify SSH public key.

title: Network Drive Mapping and Share Permissions
keywords: network drive, smb, mapped drive, nas, z drive, permission denied
content: Steps: 1. Open File Explorer. 2. Connect to \\nas.northstar.internal\shares. 3. Re-enter domain credentials. 4. Verify Active Directory group.

title: Microsoft Teams Audio and Peripheral Diagnostics
keywords: teams, audio, microphone, headset, call dropped, devices
content: Steps: 1. Open Teams Settings > Devices. 2. Run Make a Test Call. 3. Verify microphone input permissions in Windows settings. 4. Update audio drivers.

title: Suspicious Email Phishing Report & Triage
keywords: phishing, suspicious, spam, malicious attachment, report email
content: Steps: 1. Click Report Phish button in Outlook. 2. Do not click links or open attachments. 3. SecOps agent analyzes email header in sandbox.

title: External Monitor and Docking Station Troubleshooting
keywords: monitor, display, dock, thunderbolt, hdmi, screen black
content: Steps: 1. Power cycle docking station. 2. Re-seat USB-C cable. 3. Press Win + Ctrl + Shift + B to reset graphics driver. 4. Check display settings.

title: Security Incident Quarantine & Endpoint Isolation
keywords: incident, malware, virus, ransomware, isolate endpoint, edr
content: Steps: 1. Disconnect Ethernet and Wi-Fi immediately. 2. Contact SecOps hotline. 3. EDR agent initiates forensic snapshot and endpoint quarantine.

title: Salesforce CRM Lead Routing and Territory Assignment
keywords: salesforce, lead, assignment rule, queue, territory, crm
content: Steps: 1. Verify Lead Status. 2. Check Lead Assignment Rules. 3. Check user territory allocation in Setup. 4. Re-run assignment rule manually.

title: AWS Cloud Console IAM Role Assumption
keywords: aws, iam, sts, assume-role, cli, credentials, expired token
content: Steps: 1. Run aws sso login. 2. Verify active session in browser. 3. Export AWS_PROFILE. 4. If permission denied, verify AWS IAM group assignment.

title: Browser Cache and Extension Conflict Resolution
keywords: chrome, browser, cookies, cache, extension, unresponsive
content: Steps: 1. Open Chrome in Incognito mode. 2. If issue resolves, clear browser cookies and cache. 3. Disable conflicting extensions one by one.

title: Printer Network Discovery and Spooler Clearing
keywords: printer, spooler, paper jam, offline, queue stuck, print
content: Steps: 1. Restart Print Spooler service via services.msc. 2. Delete files in C:\Windows\System32\spool\PRINTERS. 3. Reconnect printer by IP.

title: Emergency Employee Account Suspension Protocol
keywords: termination, suspension, emergency, leaver, disable account
content: Steps: 1. Authenticate HR webhook or CISO authorization. 2. Trigger automated deprovisioning workflow. 3. Revoke all active sessions and cloud tokens.
